Send the application by speed post or registered post to The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, 'Deep Bhavan', 5/20, Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai 600001.
Make sure it reaches by 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Passed Matriculation or its equivalent. Should have served as an apprentice for atleast four years in a reputable firm or in a Central or State Government establishment.; OR Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognised institution. Experience: Two years practical experience in installation, maintenance and overhauling of Diesel generator sets, Air Compressors, Battery Chargers etc. Age limit: 21 to 30 years (as on closing date) Other conditions: Eligible Indian nationals only Liable to be transferred anywhere in India including Andaman & Nicobar / Lakshadweep Islands
